source: Tennessee Department of Health, Division of Vital Records and Statistics / Office of Policy, Planning and Assessment: number of deaths by county of residence (annual PDF 2009-2017 and Excel 2018-2022 county tables; originals under sources/tn_health)
note: 2009-2018 tables publish total county counts at any size ('-' means zero), consistent with the TN Health Data Release Policy (2003): counts for state, region and county totals can be shown irrespective of the number of events. The 2019-2022 Excel tables hide some counts with '*' ('figure is not displayed according to the Tennessee Department of Health guidelines for release of aggregate data to the public'); those cells are left out of this bundle, not treated as zero, and are NOT unhidden. County tables by cause exist for heart, cancer, stroke, diabetes, accidents, motor vehicle, suicide, homicide 2009-2018 and for heart, stroke, diabetes, Alzheimer's, accidents 2019-2022 (no county suicide/homicide/cancer after 2018). 'accidents' and 'mvc' have no MortalGIS measure yet.
